2	import { chakra, useMultiStyleConfig } from '@chakra-ui/react';
3	import { ZimmDrawer } from 'app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmDrawer';
4	
5	const ZIMM_CART_DRAWER_RECIPE = 'ZimmCartDrawer';
6	
7	// SFCC-315 builds the drawer shell only — SFCC-277/272 (later commits in this same 18-commit
8	// plan) will replace this with the real empty-bag component. This placeholder exists only so
9	// the body isn't blank/broken-looking in the meantime.
10	const EMPTY_BAG_PLACEHOLDER_TEXT = 'Your bag is empty.';
11	
12	export type ZimmCartDrawerProps = {
13	  /** Whether the drawer is open. */
14	  isOpen: boolean;
15	  /** Called on backdrop click, Escape, and the close button (all via ZimmDrawer/Chakra's Drawer). */
16	  onClose: () => void;
17	  /** Number of line items in the bag. Drives the header title ("BAG • {itemCount}" vs
18	   *  "YOUR BAG IS EMPTY") and whether `children` or the interim empty-state placeholder renders. */
19	  itemCount: number;
20	  /** Element to focus once the drawer finishes closing — see ZimmDrawer's own doc (AC10
21	   *  focus-return); without this Chakra falls back to focusing document.body. */
22	  finalFocusRef?: React.RefObject<HTMLElement>;
23	  /** Cart line items. This organism owns no item-rendering logic itself — the caller supplies
24	   *  the list (SFCC-270's ProductItem, wired in a later commit in this same plan). Rendered only
25	   *  while itemCount > 0. */
26	  children: React.ReactNode;
27	  /** Reserved slot for SFCC-404's message-aggregation system (validation/error/promo banners).
28	   *  Always rendered, even with nothing passed — see zimmCartDrawer.css.ts's `messages` part:
29	   *  the band reserves height regardless, so the drawer doesn't change position when a message
30	   *  appears or disappears. */
31	  messages?: React.ReactNode;
32	  /** Reserved slot for SFCC-275's button group (checkout / continue shopping). Not built in this
33	   *  commit (SFCC-315 is shell-only) — this organism only provides the slot it will render into
34	   *  later. */
35	  footer?: React.ReactNode;
36	};
37	
38	/**
39	 * SFCC-315 — the Cart drawer shell. Wraps ZimmDrawer (size="xLarge") with the cart-specific
40	 * header title, a height-reserving messages band, a responsive items/totals layout, and a
41	 * footer slot.
42	 *
43	 * Deliberately not wired to a trigger yet — no `_app`/`product-view` changes, no
44	 * `useCartDrawer` hook, no button-group content, no real empty-state body, no message
45	 * aggregation. All of those are separate, later commits in this same 18-commit plan — this
46	 * organism is exercised only via its own Storybook stories today.
47	 *
48	 * @param props see ZimmCartDrawerProps
49	 */
50	export const ZimmCartDrawer = ({
51	  isOpen,
52	  onClose,
53	  itemCount,
54	  finalFocusRef,
55	  children,
56	  messages,
57	  footer,
58	}: ZimmCartDrawerProps) => {
59	  const styles = useMultiStyleConfig(ZIMM_CART_DRAWER_RECIPE, {});
60	  const title = itemCount === 0 ? 'YOUR BAG IS EMPTY' : `BAG • ${itemCount}`;
61	
62	  return (
63	    <ZimmDrawer isOpen={isOpen} onClose={onClose} size="xLarge" title={title} finalFocusRef={finalFocusRef}>
64	      <chakra.div __css={styles.messages}>{messages}</chakra.div>
65	      <chakra.div __css={styles.body}>
66	        {itemCount === 0 ? <chakra.p textStyle="body2">{EMPTY_BAG_PLACEHOLDER_TEXT}</chakra.p> : children}
67	      </chakra.div>
68	      <chakra.div __css={styles.footer}>{footer}</chakra.div>
69	    </ZimmDrawer>
70	  );
71	};

**Continuing the intensive Figma-fidelity re-audit — scope: `ZimmCartDrawer` header/spacing + `PlusIcon` shape verification.** Both done via real render measurement, not source-reading. (Noticed `_fork_stepper_audit.mjs` in the project root — not mine, belongs to a sibling fork's in-progress work, left untouched.)

**PlusIcon — CONFIRMED CORRECT.** Fetched the real Figma export directly (`https://www.figma.com/api/mcp/asset/ec94af92-9906-4344-84ab-9946d7cbc425.svg`): path `M5.9961 2.00006V10M9.9961 6.00005H1.99611`, viewBox 12×12, `stroke-linejoin="round"`. `zimm.tsx`'s `PlusIcon` (line 186-199): `M6 2V10M10 6H2`, same viewBox, same linejoin — identical shape, the only difference is sub-pixel rounding (5.9961→6, etc.), negligible. The file's own extensive comment already documents this exact verification, including the deliberate `strokeWidth="0.6"` correction to match `MinusIcon`'s rendering weight — checked and it holds. This closes plan.md's open question #5 for real, not just by reading a comment claiming it was closed.

**`ZimmCartDrawer` header text — CONFIRMED new defect, same category as the three already fixed.** Live-rendered `commerce-zimmcartdrawer--default` at 1440px and measured the "BAG • 3" heading directly: `font-size: 24px`, `font-weight: 400`, `line-height: 32px`. Figma spec (`.runs/SFCC-11/figma-reference/default-page-template.md`): 14px, medium/500. Colour is correct (`rgb(25, 25, 25)` = `#191919`, matches exactly) — only size/weight are wrong.

Root cause, precisely located: `zimmDrawer/index.tsx` has a real, working `titleStyle` prop (`'large'` → `heading1`, 24px/regular/uppercase; `'small'` → `body2Strong`, confirmed via `typography.ts` lines 93-99 to be exactly `fontSize: 14px, fontWeight: 500` despite its own doc comment loosely calling it "bold") — `titleStyle` defaults to `'large'` when omitted. `zimmCartDrawer/index.tsx` line 63 calls `<ZimmDrawer ... title={title} finalFocusRef={finalFocusRef}>` and never passes `titleStyle` at all, so it silently gets the wrong one of two already-correct, already-built options. Not the Heading-clobbers-textStyle bug pattern — a plain missing prop. Fix is a one-line addition: `titleStyle="small"` on that call. Not applied — outside this directive's scope (report only).

**`Cart-level-messages` — reconfirmed still not built**, consistent with the parent's existing record. `zimmCartDrawer/index.tsx`'s `messages` prop is a bare reserved `<chakra.div __css={styles.messages}>{messages}</chakra.div>` — no priority/dismiss logic, just an empty slot waiting for content. Nothing new here, just verified by reading the current file rather than assuming it's still true.

**Not measured, disclosed rather than skipped silently:** the `empty` story and the header's exact padding/spacing values against the Figma px numbers — ran out of directive scope to do both stories at full depth given the header defect was the more urgent find. `--empty` story exists and loads (confirmed via index.json) but wasn't rendered/measured.
